canonical_project: eThekwini Korean AI Data Centre proposal (Amanzimtoti / Lovu River)
owner: eThekwini Municipality + Korea South Power Consortium (KOSPO-led)
notes: In early 2026 the Korea South Power Consortium approached eThekwini to build a multi-billion-rand AI data centre in Amanzimtoti (site at mouth of Lovu River near the Amanzimtoti cable landing station). eThekwini issued official 'Clarity' media statements addressing concerns; council approved an exploratory MOA - briefing documents referenced ~400MW (would be ~25% of Durban's electricity, US$3-10bn), but the municipality says MW figures are unconfirmed and the MOA is exploratory. Status per methodology: MOA/announced = lead, not yet land-use/EA/building-plan approved. Capacity 400MW as reported, unconfirmed.
